applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), effective 31 October 2012 — investment chapter, no tax treaty
Panama–Canada Free Trade Agreement, effective 1 April 2014

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 27 April 2015, as amended, constituting Panama's AML/CFT legal framework and establishing the Undida de Analisis Financiero (UAF); Law 70 of 30 November 2017, implemented by Executive Decree No. 406 of 2019 and Resolution No. 201-7907 of 23 November 2020 of the Registro Publico, creating the mandatory Registry of Final Beneficiaries (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales); and Ley 32 de 1927, as amended, which governs Sociedades Anonimas and imposes KYC obligations on licensed resident agents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport / national identity document of each UBO, director, and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the UBO's foreign country of residence or the competent issuing governmental authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from the issuing jurisdiction, or consular legalization at the Panamanian embassy/consulate if the issuing jurisdiction is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder / UBO legal entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate registry / company registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the foreign registry's competent authority; otherwise Panamanian consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Register of Directors and Officers, including the UBO table of any corporate shareholder / UBO entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The corporate registrar or a Notary Public in the foreign jurisdiction, certified by the corporate secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the notarized certificate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter, latest 3 months of financial statements, and source-of-funds / source-of-wealth declaration for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated banking institution or licensed accountant in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the document forms part of a notarized statement; otherwise consular legalization where required by the Panamanian resident agent's internal KYC policy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and the Panamanian UAF warning list. Politically Exposed Persons trigger Enhanced Due Diligence under Law 23 of 2015 and UAF implementing rules, requiring independent internal approval, source-of-wealth documentation, transaction-purpose clarification, and escalation to the resident agent's AML Compliance Officer prior to incorporation and before any Steam/console payout onboarding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Publico de Panama - Tramite de Busqueda Fonetica y Reserva de Razon Social, available through the official Panama Public Registry web portal, www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A proposed name may be in Spanish or any other language provided it is expressed in Latin characters; if the desired name uses a non-Latin script (e.g., Cyrillic, Han characters), it must be transliterated into a phonetically stable Latin-alphabet form and the corporate purpose clause must be accompanied by a Spanish translation. The corporate name must conclude with 'Sociedad Anonima', 'Corp.', 'Corporation', or 'Inc.' and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed corporate name, the applicant or its licensed Panamanian resident agent may file a written request for reconsideration (recurso de reconsideracion) with the Director General of the Registro Publico within five (5) business days of notification. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file an appeal (recurso de apelacion) to the Administative Commission of the Registro Publico within five (5) business days. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately initiate a new name search with a modified name; the rejection of an earlier proposal does not bar submission of a distinct new proposal. A judicial challenge may be pursued in Panama's administrative courts if the rejection is based on an alleged conflict with a preexisting trademark right.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address supplied by a licensed Panamanian resident agent is a valid registered office for incorporation purposes and is generally accepted for a low-risk video game publishing S.A. that issues invoices to Steam/Valve or PlayStation Store, provided the address remains a physical street address in Panama at which official legal notifications can be served. However, for a future Panama employer of record, for a local bank or payment processor account, or for any Panamanian tax-filing status beyond territorial nil-return, the virtual office alone will not satisfy commercial substance expectations and additional physical administrative presence will be required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - approximately 5% annual probability for a single-purpose low-risk Steam/console publishing vehicle with consistently filed nil territorial tax returns; the probability rises to 35% if the entity engages in physical business activity, becomes an employer in Panama, triggers suspicious payment flows, or attracts a UAF / Registro Publico audit due to untimely annual franchise tax filings or unusual share transfers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official public registry per-page copy tariff

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law of Panama), as amended; applicable sections: Articles 1-7 (formation and capital), Article 41 (officers), Article 48 (resident agent), and Article 71 (registered office).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección del Registro Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública containing the Pacto Social y Estatutos (Public Deed embodying the Articles of Incorporation), presented for mercantile inscription via the Registro Público en Línea portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum authorized capital of at least US$10,000 (B/.10,000) required by Ley 32 de 1927. No minimum paid-up or subscribed capital is required at formation, and no escrow account or bank deposit obligation applies to a standard Sociedad Anónima.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE SOCIEDAD ANÓNIMA — unanimously adopted at the initial Board meeting of ___ 20__: I. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION: The authorized capital of Ten Thousand United States Dollars (US$10,000), divided into one hundred (100) common shares of US$100 each, is fully subscribed and paid by the founders. The Secretary shall issue certificates and maintain the Share Register. II. REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered office is established at [address], City of Panama, Republic of Panama. III. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: [Name], President; [Name], Secretary; [Name], Treasurer, each vested with powers granted in the Articles of Incorporation, including corporate representation, banking and contract authority. The meeting adjourned.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Certificado de Nombre, online via Registro Público en Línea
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the official name-search petition naming the proposed corporate name (one primary and two back-up names). The Registry verifies there is no identical or confusingly similar name already inscribed and issues a Name Certificate valid for 30 days. The filing attorney must remit the certified name certificate with the incorporation package.
required_dossiers: Solicitud de Certificado de Nombre (name search application form)
Power of attorney executed by the incorporating shareholders (if filed through an agent)
Passport copy of the requesting subscriber or authorized agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected or reserved by another entity, submit up to three alternative names through the same portal; a revised certificate can be issued upon payment of the re-filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Pacto Social y Estatutos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporating attorney drafts the Articles of Incorporation in Spanish, including the corporate name, authorized capital, share classes, domicile, resident agent designation, board structure, and duration. At least two and up to unlimited founders (or their attorneys-in-fact) execute the deed before the Notary. The notary authenticates the signatures and issues the notarized instrument for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Valid Name Certificate issued by the Registro Público
Passport copies of all subscribing shareholders and initial directors
Draft Pacto Social y Estatutos
Notarial attendance and stamp-documentation forms supplied by the Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Notary may correct or clarify any technical error in the deed through an addendum before presentation to the Registry, at no additional notarial fee if the correction is made within 24 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription at the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Materias Mercantiles (Mercantile Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized deed with the Mercantile Section using the standardized inscription form. The filing must include the resident agent acceptance and the exact municipal address of the registered office. After payment of the registration tax and stamp fees, the Registry assigns a corporate folio and issues the Certificado de Inscripción, which evidences legal existence.
required_dossiers: Original notarized Escritura Pública (Pacto Social y Estatutos)
Name Certificate in force
Resident Agent acceptance form (Aceptación del Agente Residente)
Payment receipt of official registration and stamp fees
Registry filing cover form (Formulario de Inscripción)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should the Registrar issue a 'Reparo' (defect notice), the filing attorney cures the omission by presenting the corrective document within the legal term (generally up to 10 business days); if the application is denied, a formal 'Recurso de Reconsideración' may be lodged before the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance: First Board Meeting, Share Subscriptions, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office of the Sociedad Anónima / corporate law firm; optional recording of appointments at the Registro Público
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the Board of Directors, pass the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution adopting share subscription, fixing the registered office, and appointing the President, Secretary, and Treasurer. The Secretary opens the Share Register, issues share certificates, and maintains the Corporate Records Book. Minutes are signed by all directors and officers in attendance.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Inscripción (Certificate of Registration)
Articles of Incorporation (Pacto Social y Estatutos)
Pro-forma First Board Resolution and Minutes of the meeting
Share subscription documentation and certificate stubs
Registered office address confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural deficiency in the board acts may be ratified retroactively by a unanimous written resolution; amendments to the Articles, if required, are filed for registry annotation within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Municipal Operating Notice, and Post-Formation Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance; Municipio de Panamá (Aviso de Operación / Matrícula Municipal) — online portals
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) with fiscal address, economic activity classification under ISIC 5820, and tax modalities. File the municipal Aviso de Operación to register the physical office for municipal taxation; if the company hires staff, register as an employer with CSS and the Ministry of Labor and update the RUC accordingly.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Inscripción from the Registro Público
DGI Form RUC-01 (tax registration) and Form 606 updates if applicable
Municipal Aviso de Operación application
Lease contract or proof of registered office address
Fire safety inspection certificate from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos (for physical office)
Identity documents of legal representative and resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI or the Municipality issues a query, the attorney corrects RUC data and municipal declarations by affidavit; any erroneous commercial classification may be reassigned administratively, and penalties are avoided by timely response before the applicable deadline.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) — Not applicable: ISIC 5820 digital publishing of PC and console video games via digital stores involves no physical manufacturing, no industrial plant, and no sector-specific industrial operating permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific industrial operating license required; a municipal Aviso de Operación (Matrícula Municipal) suffices for any administrative office; no additional industrial licensing prerequisite for Steam/PlayStation digital distribution activities.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Categoría Exenta) — the activity is purely digital publishing with no physical industrial plant, no construction works, and no material environmental footprint; no EIA registration or Environmental Report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to pure digital operations. For any leased office, comply with municipal wastewater and solid waste ordinances (Ley 51 de 2008) and MiAMBIENTE Resolution No. 107-2020 regarding electronic waste (WEEE) recycling of IT equipment; no industrial VOC, particulate, or wastewater discharge thresholds apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for the registered office per NFPA-derived local codes; structural load and occupancy clearance through the municipal permitted-use inspection; occupational health and safety registration under Resolution No. 004-2008 of the CSS/RIESS and Ministry of Health (DIGESA) hygiene inspection for any physical workplace; minimal for a remote/virtual publishing operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Panama; taxpayer portal: Sede Electrónica de la DGI (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Panamanian S.A. must be duly registered with the Registro Público de Panamá and must obtain a RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) before commencing taxable business. The foreign-owner procedure is: (1) execute and notarize the corporation's by-laws/powers and register the company and its resident legal representative with the Public Registry; (2) appoint and maintain a resident agent and designate a branch/registered address in Panama; (3) file with DGI, through a licensed Panamanian attorney or CPA, the RUC registration application, the Public Registry certificate, legal representative's identity/passport copy and proof of address; (4) obtain the RUC number, which simultaneously operates as the ITBMS (VAT) registration identifier; (5) if physical or local activity is conducted, obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación. For a purely offshore digital publisher not maintaining a Panama office, the DGI still expects the S.A. to hold RUC for corporate filing purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope — the S.A. is an entity-level taxable corporation but is taxed only on Panama-source income; foreign-source revenue, including offshore digital game publishing income received from Steam/Valve and PlayStation Store, is generally excluded from Panamanian corporate income tax. Non-resident ownership is permissible and does not create a permanent-establishment/nexus difference.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide IRS-style 'check-the-box' elections or hybrid mismatch elections for S.A.s. The territorial regime is mandatory. Available elections are limited to tax-accounting matters, e.g., depreciation methods and, where applicable, the small-taxpayer simplified ITBMS regime for low-turnover micro-businesses; a corporate digital publisher will not normally qualify for the simplified regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) — Panama VAT/GST on goods and services
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis turnover threshold (B/.0.00) for registration as a corporate taxpayer. A Panamanian S.A. must obtain RUC/ITBMS registration before making taxable transfers or providing services in Panama. Small taxpayers may have a simplified ITBMS-collection regime, but it is not applicable to an ordinary S.A. engaged in Steam/console publishing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing for DGI-registered taxpayers under the Facturación Electrónica framework. Invoices must be generated through an authorized billing system or the DGI's free electronic invoicing platform, digitally signed by the taxpayer's Panamanian e-signature certificate, and transmitted to DGI in real time through API/web-service integration. The DGI validates the invoice, assigns a unique fiscal authorization/stamp, and returns a validation code and QR code for the printable customer copy. For platform payouts, invoices to the platform or supporting zero-rated export invoices must carry the DGI clearance data; failure to issue compliant e-invoices can create penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For physical goods, 0% ITBMS applies only when title passes and goods physically leave Panama, evidenced by an accepted export declaration. For digital game publishing through Steam and PlayStation Store, the supply of games/licenses to non-resident end users is treated as an export/offshore service eligible for 0% ITBMS when the customer is outside Panama and the game is received, used or downloaded outside Panama. The publisher must separate Panamanian end-user sales (subject to 7% ITBMS) from non-Panamanian sales (0% or outside scope). Platform settlements received from Valve/Sony are acceptable payment evidence, but DGI scrutiny will focus on the location and identity of end users and the place where the digital service is exploited.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) for physical goods; for digital supplies, the platform settlement/export report from Steam/Valve or PlayStation Store
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill for physical exports; digital distribution statement showing non-resident account locations for digital exports
Commercial invoice and packing list for physical shipments; platform purchase/sales reports and payout statements for digital sales
License or publishing agreement with Valve/PlayStation evidencing the territories, rights, and non-resident end-user market
Bank/inward remittance certificate, SWIFT credit advice, or USD payout statement evidencing receipt of export proceeds
DGI ITBMS tax returns and zero-rated export schedule identifying the invoices and documentary evidence
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may reclassify claimed zero-rated/offshore supplies as taxable Panama-source services if documentation is missing or end users are actually located in Panama. Reassessment will collect unpaid ITBMS at 7%, add statutory interest and surcharges, and impose fines for the omitted tax, typically up to 100% of the deficiency. False export declarations, fabricated offshore user evidence, or abusive arrangements intended to avoid 7% ITBMS can trigger criminal tax-fraud prosecution, personal liability of directors/legal representatives, and retrospective clawback of any refunds or VAT credits claimed. Panama does not impose foreign-exchange repatriation controls; the 180-day field represents the administrative documentary benchmark used for export-substantiation files.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) acting as the banking and foreign exchange regulator under Decreto Ley 9 of 1998; Banco Nacional de Panamá serves as fiscal agent of the State. Panama has no conventional central bank and no monetary authority issuing national paper currency. The Panamanian balboa is a nominal coin-only unit statutorily pegged 1:1 to the United States dollar, and the USD is legal tender and the default settlement currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current and capital account convertibility. The economy is dollarized; capital injections, dividend distributions, branch remittances and liquidation proceeds can be transferred without prior exchange approval. Profit repatriation is subject only to ordinary Panamanian tax rules. For this entity, digital-store publishing revenue collected from non-Panamanian marketplaces qualifies as foreign-source income under Panama Law 8 of 2010 and Executive Decree 476 of 2011, provided that no Panamanian end-user market is served and no Panamanian permanent establishment exists; therefore no taxable remittance or withholding obstacle is expected. The site of digital game purchases must be contractually documented at the Steam and PlayStation marketplace level to preserve the foreign-source characterization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender requirement applies to export or platform proceeds in Panama. Receipts from Valve (Steam) and Sony (PlayStation Store) may remain in USD indefinitely at a licensed commercial bank. The SBP requires no declaration for a standard software-publishing treasury flow; however, the bank will expect monthly platform payout evidence and a tax-situs memorandum prepared by a licensed Panamanian attorney.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - USD corporate checking and treasury concentration
Operational Account - USD corporate current account with correspondent clearing
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account hybrid
Operational Account - USD trade and merchant clearing account
Operational Account - USD institutional multi-currency wrapper
Operational Account - USD merchant funding and platform payout account
Capital Escrow Account - USD private holding account
Operational Account - USD state-linked corporate account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury rail, acceptable only as a secondary receivable conduit. Panama does not operate an EU-style Electronic Money Institution licensing regime, so a Panama S.A. cannot obtain a locally licensed EMI with passported clearing access. Cross-border platforms (Payoneer, Mercury, Airwallex, Wise Business) may accept the entity on a discretionary basis; Payoneer is the most practical bridge for Valve/Steam settlements, while Sony PlayStation payout contracts generally require classical SWIFT wires to a legal-entity bank account. The recommended structure is a Tier-1 Panama bank USD master account for all liquidity, with a Payoneer sub-account restricted to Steam receivable concentration and swept weekly into the master account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No national statute compels all directors and shareholders to appear physically at a bank branch, but SBP risk-management rules require banks to verify every beneficial owner. In practice, Tier-1 private banks permit remote onboarding of non-resident owners when (a) the Panamanian resident agent submits a legal opinion on corporate existence, (b) apostilled board minutes are registered in the Public Registry, (c) passport and address proof of each signatory and shareholder are notarized and apostilled, and (d) the compliance officer completes a recorded videoconference interview. Banco Nacional de Panamá and Towerbank currently require a physical branch appearance of at least one director or of a legal representative holding a notarized power of attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders in a single-purpose Panama S.A. with no local immigration record and no apparent business substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal opinion from a locally licensed attorney certifying valid incorporation; apostilled notarized board resolution appointing signatories; apostilled passport bio-pages and utility bills for all ultimate owners; group organizational chart; audited or internally certified gaming-publishing track record; confirmation that the entity has filed its beneficial-ownership information in Panama's official registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Private interest foundation (PIF) or multi-layered holding chain obscuring the true economic owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foundation charter with current apostille; foundation council attestation identifying the protector and letter of wishes holder; nil-beneficiary certification if no bearer instruments exist; interlocking legal opinion mapping the foundation to the Panama S.A. and confirming that no nominee shares are outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-store transaction velocity with numerous small-value purchases and recurring royalty remittances between Steam, PlayStation and related service providers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Steamworks agreement and PlayStation Partner program documentation; monthly settlement statements from Valve and Sony for the prior 12 months; treasury ledger tracing each inflow to a specific game title; release calendar and sales forecast; an AML review report prepared by a Panamanian certified public accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inability to demonstrate the foreign-tax situs of income from PC and console game downloads.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform country-of-purchase report showing that no Panamanian end-user market is serviced; taxation memorandum of a licensed Panamanian tax adviser applying Law 8 of 2010 and Executive Decree 476 of 2011; standard distribution agreements proving that Valve and Sony act as independent marketplace operators rather than agents of the Panama entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicion of politically exposed persons, gambling, loot-box monetization, or sanctions exposure in the payment chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO declaration certifying no PEP status; ESRB and IARC age-rating certificates for all catalog titles; statement that the entity operates no gambling or betting mechanics; sanctions-screening report at the corporate level covering all counterparties in the Steam and PlayStation payment chain; external ethics attestation from the platform settlement officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Dispatch all capital contributions via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's existing bank account using the BPM6 balance-of-payments classification code for equity capital; a suitable wire reference is PA_CORP S.A. - CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - BOARD RESOLUTION OF [DATE] - NON-REIMBURSABLE. The receiving bank must be instructed to book the credit as direct investment equity and not as a loan. Attach the notarized capital increase or shareholder resolution and a funds-viability letter from a licensed Panamanian CPA. Because the USD is legal tender, no conversion is required; no SBP approval is applicable. For shareholder loans, execute a formal promissory note with arm's-length OECD-compliant interest and record the charge where the approved bank facility threshold applies.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail for trade obligations is SWIFT MT103. Valve/Steam settlements typically arrive through Payoneer from a US partner bank; Sony PlayStation settlements arrive by classical MT103 from the PlayStation partner treasury. Payments for engine royalties, middleware licenses, localization, marketing and distribution support should be sent via MT103 using purpose codes for trade-related services and cross-border fees, with the text line reflecting ISIC 5820 PC and console publishing services. Commercial documentary letters of credit are neither customary nor suitable for digital store payables; the contingency rail is a virtual account minute with an SBP-licensed correspondent for same-day USD concentration and a Payoneer bridge account for Steam receivable concentration only.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: No derivative product is necessary because the Panama entity is USD-functional and all platform contracts are denominated and settled in USD.
Plain vanilla FX forwards with an SBP-licensed bank are permissible when ancillary EUR or GBP marketplace receivables need hedging against the USD.
FX swaps for short-term liquidity management between EUR/USD and GBP/USD are permissible without a special local license.

Non-deliverable forwards are not relevant for USD/PAB because the balboa is a pseudo-fixed coin-only currency at 1:1 and no central bank maintains a reserve currency benchmark; NDFs could be executed only via non-resident dealing rooms and are not recommended for this treasury.

Cross-currency swaps are legally available under general Panamanian commercial law but are considered exotic instruments for a digital-store balance sheet and are neither necessary nor recommended at this scale.

stage_5.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Rules regarding annual confirmation for shareholding transfers
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat rate on Panama-source net taxable income
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation regime: foreign-source income derived from abroad is exempt unless attributable to a Panamanian permanent establishment. No statutory tax holiday for standard S.A. software publishers. Special regimes (SEM headquarters, Panama Pacífico, City of Knowledge) are available only upon qualifying relocation/hiring commitments. Digital store distribution income attributable to active Panamanian operations is taxed at the standard 25% composite rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 206 - Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta (Personas Jurídicas); mandatory electronic filing via DGI E-Tax 2.0 portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; taxpayers may be required to file provisional quarterly declarations and advance tax payments under the fiscal-year cash-flow regime
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For calendar-year entities: on or before 31 March of the following year. For fiscal-year entities ending other than 31 December: no later than 3 months after the fiscal year-end. A 2-month extension is available on written request with justified cause.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number (Registro Único de Contribuyente) of the S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent or shareholder must ensure the Panamanian entity maintains an active RUC and lists all non-resident directors/shareholders in the annual registry form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Start and end date of the fiscal year being declared.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a newly incorporated non-resident owned S.A., the first fiscal period may be less than 12 months; declare exact dates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 13 - Ingresos Brutos de Fuente Panameña
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from Panama-source activities, including digital game sales through Steam and PlayStation stores if sales are deemed attributable to Panamanian operations or to a Panamanian principal/ distributor.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident controlled S.A. must disclose only Panama-source digital store revenue; foreign-source revenue should be supported by evidence of foreign permanent establishment or foreign incorporation of target players.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary and necessary business expenses, including Steam/Valve revenue sharing fees, PlayStation Store platform commissions, marketing, salaries, software development costs, and amortization of game licenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Platform fees paid to Valve Corporation or Sony Interactive Entertainment are deductible when supported by invoices and service contracts, provided those providers are not related parties on non-arm's length terms.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable Panama-source income after deductions and loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent must ensure intercompany pricing is documented; any unused loss carryforward is recorded in the control ledger for the 5-year limitation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 30 - ISR Causado a la Tarifa del 25%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computed by applying 25% to the net taxable income in Box 22.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No reduction is available for non-resident parent taxes; foreign tax credits are available only if the foreign tax was paid on Panama-source income under a double-tax treaty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits for withholding taxes suffered on Panama-source payments (e.g., interest, royalties, services) during the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident lenders and licensors that had withholding tax imposed at the statutory rate may invoke the applicable DTA only through the annual refund or credit mechanism.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 40 - Total a Pagar / Saldo a Favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable after credits and prepayments, or refundable tax balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any refund to a non-resident parent entity is subject to audit and must be supported by TRC and tax payment vouchers.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a surcharge of 1.25% per month (15% annualized) on the unpaid tax plus a fine equivalent to 5% per month of the tax due, capped at 50%. Failure to file after notice may result in additional DGI assessment of USD 100 to USD 5,000, administrative seizure of bank accounts, and for willful evasion, criminal prosecution with imprisonment of 2 to 6 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% withholding tax on dividends paid from Panama-source profits to both resident and non-resident shareholders. If the corporation opts for the 2% complementary tax on distributable income, the applicable rate on actual distributions may be reduced to 3%; if dividends are paid from retained untaxed Panama-source profits, the 5% withholding tax applies in full.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim dividend treaty relief, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Certificate of Fiscal Residence (TRC) from its home tax authority, apostilled or legalized as required, and submit the TRC, together with the Formulario de Solicitud de Aplicación de Convenio para Evitar la Doble Imposición and a current shareholding certificate, to the DGI or to the paying entity for reduced withholding at source. For a refund route, the shareholder files the Claim for Refund (Solicitud de Devolución) within the statutory period, typically 2 years from the end of the fiscal year. Panama applies the LOB/beneficial ownership clause before granting relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 10% on Panama-source interest and royalty paid by a Panamanian S.A. to a non-resident. Treaty-reduced rates (e.g., 5%-10% on royalties and 10% on interest) are available under Panama's comprehensive DTA network (including UK, France, Spain, Switzerland, Netherlands, Mexico, Portugal, and Singapore). Royalties from video game IP exploitation through Steam/PlayStation stores must be distinguished from platform service commissions; commission payments are not royalties and are not subject to the 10% royalty withholding, but may be subject to Panama-source service income taxation if the provider maintains a Panamanian presence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File documentation is triggered when annual consolidated gross revenue exceeds B/. 2,000,000 (USD 2,000,000) or when related-party transactions, including cross-border platform fee payments, royalties, and management charges, individually or collectively exceed B/. 1,000,000 (USD 1,000,000). The Panamanian entity must file the Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form (Formulario Anexo de Precios de Transferencia) together with the annual income tax return; full transfer pricing study must be available within 30 working days of DGI request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Yes. Panama Economic Substance Regulations (Ley 254 de 2020 and Reglamento de la Ley 254) apply to resident legal entities engaged in specified relevant activities. A video game publishing company deriving digital distribution and IP royalty income from Steam and PlayStation is potentially caught as either a 'distribution and service centre' or 'intellectual property business'. The S.A. must demonstrate adequate physical office, board meetings, qualified employees, operating expenditure, and decision-making presence in Panama. Outsourced development to a foreign related party does not satisfy substance. Exemptions exist for non-tax-resident entities whose effective management is not in Panama, but such entities must be separately reportable under the mandatory registration regime.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating or omitting Panama-source digital store revenue in the Formulario 206, inflating platform costs, or disguising Steam/PlayStation dividends and profit-share payments as tax-deductible royalties or commissions to a related offshore entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penal Code of Panama: imprisonment of 2 to 6 years plus a fine equal to 3 to 9 times the evaded tax. Administrative penalty of 100%-200% of the omitted tax and delinquency surcharge of 1.25% per month; seizure of bank accounts and judicial collection of unpaid taxes are automatic.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent who sign a knowingly false return are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, penalties, and interest. Courts may impose travel bans, preventive detention, and 2-6 year custodial sentences. Corporate veil piercing is available under Articles 152-161 of the Panamanian Corporation Law where fraud or abuse of the S.A. structure is shown.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Panama S.A. with no physical office, no local employees, no independently controlled bank account, and claiming foreign-source exemption or treaty benefits while the software publishing activity is managed from another jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Regulations: annual penalties of USD 10,000 for first offense, USD 20,000 for second offense, and up to USD 100,000 or five (5) times the relevant income for continued noncompliance, whichever is higher. DGI may file for judicial winding-up, cancellation of the RUC, and revocation of the resident agency license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign a false economic substance declaration are personally liable for the penalty amounts, and resident agents can be deregistered. Repeat offenses justify disqualification of directors from any Panama company and freezing of personal assets where the entity is an alter ego of the ultimate beneficial owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring excessive management fees, platform commissions, or royalty payments to a related-party non-resident entity to shift Panama-source profit out of the 25% territorial tax base, particularly when no valid arm's length study exists or when the foreign payee lacks economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI may adjust taxable income upward using the most appropriate arm's length method, applying a 25% tax on the adjustment plus a penalty of 40% to 100% of the additional tax due, plus monthly surcharges. Non-filing of the transfer pricing annex is fined USD 500 to USD 10,000; late filing of the corresponding documentation is fined USD 100 to USD 2,000 per day.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve related-party contracts without an arm's length study can be held civilly liable for the tax adjustment and penalties. In cases of fraudulent documentation, criminal liability extends to imprisonment and travel bans, based on the tax fraud provisions of the Penal Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using bearer shares or unreported nominees to obscure the actual owner while receiving digital store profits, failing to file the beneficial ownership return with the Registro Público de Panamá, or processing Steam/PlayStation payouts through an unlicensed financial intermediary to evade scrutiny.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Panama AML Law (Ley 5 de 2021): fines from USD 10,000 to USD 500,000 for entities, and cancellation of corporate registration for persistent failure to disclose ultimate beneficial owners. Criminal money laundering penalties: 5 to 12 years' imprisonment plus fine of 1 to 5 times the laundered amount. The Superintendency of Non-Financial Entities (ARAP) may suspend the resident agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and the resident agent who failed to identify the natural person behind the company may be sanctioned jointly and severally. Travel bans and freezing of personal funds are standard enforcement tools; criminal proceedings can pierce the corporate veil to seize company assets beneficially owned by the director personally.
